title: Europe must weigh rising Ukraine costs against higher price of Russian victory
gist: Peter Dickinson argues that Russia's escalated bombing of Ukraine's economy (ports closed, NBU now sees 2026 GDP -0.4%) has pushed Kyiv to seek almost $80B in extra 2027 funding, and that however politically painful, Europe's cost of funding Ukraine is far smaller than the cost of a Russian victory: up to 20M refugees, a tripling-to-quadrupling of European defense spending, and decades of global trade fragmentation.

insights.speaker: Peter Dickinson
insights.so_what: Ukraine's sovereign financing need is rising; watch EU budget and bond-financed support packages.
